description_en: Modifies an Express Cloud Connection (ECC) instance
description_zh: 调用ModifyExpressCloudConnectionAttribute修改高速上云服务连接
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-express-cloud-connection-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ecc-id ecc-bp1t9osmuln0000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyExpressCloudConnectionAttribute

parameters.help_en: The description of the Express Cloud Connection instance
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Express Cloud Connection instance
parameters.help_zh: 高速上云服务实例所在的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the Express Cloud Connection instance
parameters.help_zh: 高速上云服务实例名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Express Cloud Connection instance
parameters.name: ecc_id

parameters.help_en: The local BGP autonomous system (AS) number to be configured on the Smart Access Gateway device
parameters.help_zh: 指智能接入网关设备上需要配置的本地BGP的AS号
parameters.name: bgp_as

parameters.help_en: The local IP address of the Smart Access Gateway device used for peering with the cloud
parameters.help_zh: 指智能接入网关设备和云上对接时的本地IP
parameters.name: pe_ip

parameters.help_en: The cloud-side IP address used for peering with the Smart Access Gateway device
parameters.help_zh: 指智能接入网关设备和云上对接时的云端IP
parameters.name: ce_ip
